name: Leah
source:
Leah's height makes her perfect for standing in front the goalie and blocking their view, as well as deflecting shots to make them harder to save. However, she often moves on first instinct instead of analyzing the situation, which can get her in trouble outside the rink as well. She is Ethan's long time girlfriend.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37386]Lemmasoftl[/url]]
